english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for copying a model, pattern, appearance, or behavior.

exampleSentences.english: I imitate my teacher's handwriting all the time.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我成日模仿老師嘅筆跡。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jat6 mou4 fong2 lou5 si1 ge3 bat1 zik1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when copying a person's speech, behaviour, or style.

exampleSentences.english: I usually emulate the way my mother speaks.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我平時都係模仿阿媽講嘢。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 dou1 hai6 mou4 fong2 aa3 maa1 gong2 je5

english.note: Use this for copying a person's actions, behaviour, style, or movements rather than reproducing an object.

exampleSentences.english: Don't copy me all the time.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 mou4 fong2 ngo5
